{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for the consolidation of democratic transitions in Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, and Yemen will continue.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Engagement with governments and civil society across the region will continue on behalf of genuine efforts to promote political and economic reforms that are responsive to the people of the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Arab Spring represents the world's most sweeping recent movement toward democracy.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"People across the globe are demanding more from their governments.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to find support and partnership for people demanding more from their governments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A combination of sanctions and engagement was successfully employed to encourage the government of Burma to open up political space and release political prisoners.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The historic opening to Burma will continue to incentivize a democratic transition.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The historic opening to Burma will continue to incentivize deeper engagement with the United States.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The historic opening to Burma will continue to incentivize national reconciliation among Burma's many different ethnic groups.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because human rights violations persist in Burma, the United States will continue to speak clearly about the additional steps that must be taken for the government of Burma to have a better relationship with the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
